$comment: How a merchant string from the bank is SHOWN.
The bank sends merchants in capitals — 'NETFLIX.COM', 'OPAL AUCKLAND ST' —
and a list of them reads as a wall of shouting beside expenses written the
way people write. An all-caps merchant is shown with each space-separated
word capitalised; anything already in mixed case is left exactly as it is,
because somebody wrote it that way on purpose ('iTunes', 'McDonald's').
The same form seeds the NOTE of an expense or rule made from a charge.
Display only. Matching, the recurring rules' patterns and what is stored as
the charge all keep the raw string: a rule written against 'NETFLIX.COM'
apps/ios/Gastos/Core/MerchantName.swift display); both run every case here.
